source_anchors.operation: NamesOfAnnotationState literals "no ID", "single ID", "multiple IDs (identical)", "multiple IDs (divergent)"; native AnnotationState::NAMES
BaseFeature(const BaseFeature&, UInt64 map_index) stamps meta value map_index on every peptide identification; native clone_with_map_index
sortPeptideIdentifications sorts through reverse iterators with a mutating comparator that answers less for two empty identifications and reads isHigherScoreBetter from the left operand only
getAnnotationState dispatches on id_matches_ emptiness; legacy branch collects best-hit sequences of a sorted copy, so two identifications of which one is empty yield MULTIPLE_SAME
getPrimaryID throws Exception::MissingInformation when no ID was assigned; native Error::MissingInformation
updateIDReferences swaps id_matches_ out before translating, so a throwing translate leaves a partially translated set; native two-phase update is atomic
RefTranslator::translate(ObservationMatchRef) throws MissingInformation unless allow_missing; native ReferenceTranslator has no allow_missing mode
applyMemberFunction applies a Size-returning member to the feature and recursively to every subordinate, accumulating the results; native for_each_unique_id / count_unique_ids
updateAllIDReferences updates the feature then recurses into subordinates, leaving a partly translated tree on failure; native verify-then-apply
struct Ratio: user-provided default constructor leaves ratio_value_ uninitialised and description_ has no Rust field
setRatios takes a non-const std::vector<Ratio>& and cannot be called with a temporary or a const vector; native set_ratios takes the vector by value
addRatio push_back, setRatios copy assignment and both getRatios overloads, none of which validate
computeDechargeConsensus subtracts Constants::PROTON_MASS_U while ConsensusFeature_test.cpp builds its m/z fixtures from the hydrogen atom mass; the port uses the proton constant on both sides
